entities.name: Pendrell Vale
entities.description: A misty valley in Tolaria whose strange magics inhibit summoning magic.

entities.name: Tabernacle at Pendrell Vale
entities.description: The mysterious Tabernacle at the center of the vale, worshipped by certain wizards.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: Whose failed time travel experiments may have caused the vale's properties.

entities.name: Tolaria
entities.description: The island where the vale lay, later destroyed.

events.summary: After the destruction of Tolaria the vale's magic continues, calling certain wizards to worship the Tabernacle.
events.quote: calling out to certain wizards who took to worship the ancient Tabernacle
